study: Wine image-only Form and transparency diagnostics

stages.name: image-forms
stages.hypothesis: Image-only ordinary/isolated Form XObjects with unit, generous-unit or page bounds preserve original image transform tokens and payloads. Test black endpoints, clipped x/y gray ramps, in-page RGB, and actual image-only/mixed pages without zoom-dependent geometry. Half-opacity positives and independent cold native repeats retain parser/compositing failures.

independent_mupdf_construction_check.role: Independent construction check, not source of truth

limitations: The five opaque forms retain original net image transform tokens and mathematical support; Form bounding-box clipping and isolated-group compositing still change some raster pixels.
Half opacity is explicitly non-equivalent and is used only to demonstrate that the construction paints and changes output.
Follow-up scales and the mixed-page candidate repeat were selected after observing the 75% pilot. They reuse identical PDF bytes without fitted coordinates or any zoom argument.
MuPDF is an independent construction check, not the source of truth. Its raster differences are reported separately from Wine native/PDF comparisons.
Only four original control sources and pages1/5/10 of one pinned actual source are measured here; this is not a new full-cohort or runtime-parity sweep.
No general endpoint/resampling correction, new production dependency/API/I/O behavior, merge or release is claimed. #543/#541/#406 remain open.
